Cons (from solo perspective, who the fwuck has time for friends amirite; lookin at you Elden Ring Nightreign, you abusive PE teacher piece of ♥♥♥♥♥)
- enemy AI is underdeveloped
- pickups arent satisfying UX
- no IT community confirmation on whether or not its invading your kernel to mine bitcoin
- character art is all samey if you arent into generic korean/chinese game visuals
- ZZZ season 1 levels are literally more fun; I could stand still and kill every wave because they spawn in a large group like a bunch of Harvestmen and run at me with no regard for their safety.
- grinding is not a game mechanic
- no it isnt
- this game doesnt do anything interesting or different, its just "yet another looter shooter that somehow manages to have mobile-acceptable UX despite being made in Unreal 4.
- i have gear slots for armor but it doesnt show on my character? I get that the art house is working on paid DLC but come on; spend some money on me if you want me to spend some money on you
- cosmetics are a terrible, terrible idea for this genre. I cant see the front of my character most of the time, sprays and emotes are for Fortnite lobbies, avatars and profile clutter are battlepass fodder, and weapon skins and weapon trinkets . . . in a third person shooter . . . maybe ship the game with a free magnifying glass (seriously who am i showing off too here? My own friends? Am I stupid? Why would I waste narcissism on people who already like me?)
- uninspired character proficiency unlocks
- unisnpired power progression model . . . seriously you made it look like a talent tree but its all percent increases and I was able to max the first and the 4th thing in the first weapon tree branch after 5 levels. You didn't build a progression system, you gave me a chore.
- its no longer a roguelike which was an infinitely better model but you are struggling and Warframe seems like it has a lot of notes on Tumblr so why not do that instead. You've even got the perks dictionary multiple screens away from the "gear" it appears on because of how thrown together this was, but I get it; papa tencent wants their infinite growth.
- You dont care about your lore. Like Marvel Rivals, you've got multiple story beats buried in throwaway progression systems rather than built in compelling or even interesting ways (except you dont have the benefit of decades of marvel content) because you are BEGGING people to give a ♥♥♥♥♥ (please click this lore to get free resources to put into our trash power progression system thats just designed to catapult you to endgame in the first place oh and by the way, the lore you clicked was ALSO a resource to unlock a mysterious button called "Unlock Story" that is probably just as disappointing, i dunno, im still FWUCKING GRINDING) and I'm confident theres a narrative designer over there who desperately wanted to tell a good story but theres just one problem: no one reads anymore. Except people on Instagram who like Sarah Maas fantasy fiction pr0n but lets face it, they are mostly listening to the audio books. You owed your poor narrative designer better than this.
- You're early game level design is ass. I'm not sure what the rest looks like yet, but you don't convince people your levels are worth playing in the early game by stacking 10 crates at the end of the level as some sort of bonus for not falling asleep, or creating engagement spaces that actively work against mechanics you coded (i repeatedly wasted E shots on Diana because my back was to a rail, the ability propels her backward, and there was a pointless soda machine too narrow to hide behind but far enough away from the rail for me to accidentally propel myself behind it and have the E shot explode on the geo. or some other inane set piece.
- Rogueteers . . . ok I take it back about the narrative designer being owed recompense. (seriously why do we always try to reinvent the wheel here; its a rite of passage at this point. and its even more of a gaffe because it used to be a roguelite, but it wasnt clever then either)
- I think any company that doesn't disclose that they are even partially funded by Tencent in the Steam page is up to something. Dubious in nature. Very icky. No good.
- Perks and Potential UI tells me nothing about what those things are. I assume perks are what you used to get during roguelite runs and potential are things you are still unlocking to have drop during your run (which is weakened by the fact that the runs are literally 2 rooms now, but i digress).
- your start screen freezes as soon as you click the start button so there is very little feedback that it worked.

pros
- boss fights are ok, but too short and with too few mechanics
- animations are ok, but the art house is probably wildly underpaid so its bittersweet
- didnt see any issues with rigging or shaders
- theres passion and talent here, but the landscape is insanely competitive
